item.title: beacon.min.js - 2026-10-16
item.description:
1. Bug fix to ignore same-page soft navigations when the URL does not change
  2. Google's web-vitals library upgraded to version 6.2.3
  3. Further improvements of OS version collection on iOS/MacOS

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2026-10-05
item.description:
1. Allow __cfBeacon JavaScript object to override data-cf-beacon configuration
  2. Improved OS version collection on iOS/MacOS
  3. Improved backwards compatibility with ES2017 transpilation
  4. Google's web-vitals library upgraded to version 6.2.2

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2026-09-02
item.description:
1. Bug fix to prevent rounding of Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
  2. Polyfills introduced for Array.prototype.findLast and .at to improve browser compatibility
  3. Google's web-vitals library upgraded to version 6.2.1
  4. OS/browser/engine versions included in beacon payload
  5. Timing durations rounded to 1 millisecond to minimise beacon payload size

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2026-08-20
item.description: Updated Google's web-vitals library to version 6.1.0. In order to improve the accuracy of tracking soft navigations (i.e. those used by Single Page Applications), we've introduced support for Google's new Soft Navigations API available in Chromium-based browsers (e.g. Chrome, Edge, Opera) and added an improved fallback for non-Chromium browsers (e.g. Safari and Firefox) using the Navigation API. For more information, see Web Analytics for SPAs.

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2026-07-13
item.description: The beacon script is now injected with type="module" to intentionally exclude long EOL'd (End-of-Life'd) browsers like Internet Explorer from loading the script, given they don't support it anyway. See FAQ entry for more information.

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2026-06-16
item.description: Updated Google's web-vitals library to version 5.3.0 and updated the JavaScript build output target to ES2015.

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2026-05-15
item.description: Updated Google's web-vitals library to version 4.2.4 and captured Interaction to Next Paint (INP) sub-part metrics (Input Delay, Processing Duration, Presentation Delay)

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2024-06-11
item.description: Enhanced to include reporting of Server-Timing headers.

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2024-05-22
item.description: Introducing new metric fields, transferSize and decodedBodySize are included.

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2024-04-17
item.description: Introducing new metric fields, deliveryType (dt) and navigationType (nt) are included.

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2023-10-18
item.description: Manages A/B testing tags.

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2023-07-25
item.description: Fixed ETag format in the response header.

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2023-07-13
item.description: Fixed the issue that was causing an illegal invocation error.

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2023-04-19
item.description: Reports additional LCP diagnostic information using web-vitals library's attribution build.

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2023-04-06
item.description: Updated webpack configuration to output code in ECMAScript 3 (ES3) format.

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2023-03-23
item.description: Updated Google's web-vitals library (version 3.1.1) and removed experimental server-timing header.

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2022-10-17
item.description: Updated to report new metrics such as time to first byte (TTFB), interaction to next paint (INP), and first contentful paint (FCP). Additionally, it reports navigator.webdriver, server-timing header (experimental), and protocol info (nextHopProtocol).

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2021-12-14
item.description: Improved site filtering.

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2021-11-16
item.description: When using the automatic installation feature of the JavaScript Beacon (available only to customers proxied through Cloudflare - also known as orange-clouded customers), Subresource Integrity (SRI) is now enabled by default. SRI is a security feature that enables browsers to verify that resources they fetch are delivered without unexpected manipulation.

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2021-09-01
item.description: Improved to report debugging information for Core Web Vitals.

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2021-05-28
item.description: startsWith function replaced with indexOf function, which prevents rendering if multiple beacon scripts are loaded.

item.title: beacon.min.js - 2021-05-12
item.description: Reporting endpoint changed from /cdn-cgi/beacon/performance to /cdn-cgi/rum (for Browser Insights only).
